insight: Began as an open-source library for continuous validation of ML models and data, then extended into LLM evaluation.
name: Deepchecks
tagline: Testing-first evaluation and monitoring for LLM and ML systems.
description: Deepchecks brings a testing-first approach to AI quality. Its open-source Python library validates ML models and data from research through production, and the LLM Evaluation product extends that into continuous validation of LLM applications — measuring quality, performance, and pitfalls across experimentation and production with CI/CD hooks. Enterprise deployment runs in VPC, on-prem, or bare metal for teams that can't use cloud-hosted eval.

modelSupport.notes: Evaluates any LLM- or ML-based application regardless of the underlying model.

edge: Roots in classic ML validation give a testing-first model, plus VPC/on-prem/bare-metal deployment for teams that can't send evals to the cloud.
pros: Covers both ML and LLM validation
cons: AGPL-3.0 may not suit all teams
